name: 西游记2006之最终幻想
english_name: Journey to the West 2006: Final Fantasy (AKAI Studio / Tomud)
english_description: A Journey to the West mythology MUD from AKAI Studio's Tomud-branded lineage, byte-identical in file layout and bug set to this collection's sibling xyj2006n (down to sharing the same client-detection gate: the first line sent after connecting must be the bare literal "2060", the automatic reply from Tomud/"Smiling Proud Wanderer" clients, or the connection is dropped as illegal). New characters start at a South City Inn and can apprentice into the Lingtai Fangcun Mountain / Three-Star Cave sect under second-generation disciple Guang Yunzi; a gift-giving NPC there hands new arrivals a free starter set of thirteen basic skills.
